summary: First read of the slate. Best pre-game spots: Philadelphia at Detroit (Detroit without Jalen Duren), Cleveland in the rematch at OKC, and Minnesota only at a generous price with Anthony Edwards out. Watch Atlanta's Jalen Johnson (questionable): if he sits and Sarr plays, Washington at 2.20+ becomes a bet. Next check updates these with fresh injury news.

games.note: Line moved hard to Atlanta while the public backs Washington. Jalen Johnson (ATL) and Alex Sarr (WAS) both questionable; Johnson out + Sarr in would flip this to about a coin flip.
Top-two East matchup. Detroit without starting centre Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe; Embiid on a minutes limit last game. Philadelphia priced about fair, small value at 2.15+.

pick.reason: Detroit missing Duren; PHI 7-1 and close to a coin flip.

games.note: Kon Knueppel expected to make his season debut for Charlotte; Coby White probable but likely limited. Brooklyn 1-6.
Boston big favourite. Tatum questionable (rest), Giannis questionable/probable. If Tatum sits and Giannis plays, Milwaukee climbs to about 22%.
Knicks heavy favourites; Josh Hart questionable. Chicago 1-6.
Utah 1-6 and blown out last game. New Orleans off a 135-134 win in Memphis.
Indiana without Haliburton; Oubre, Toppin and Zubac questionable. Five-game losing streak. Fair price on Indiana about 3.25.
Rematch two days after OKC won 117-112 in Cleveland. OKC without Holmgren; Cleveland healthy.

pick.reason: Healthy Cleveland vs OKC missing Holmgren; fair price about 2.33.

games.note: Anthony Edwards OUT for Minnesota. Houston 7-1 and 7-1 against the spread. Only worth it at a generous number.

pick.reason: Thin edge only at 3.70+; pass below that.

games.note: Toronto without Kawhi Leonard; Poeltl questionable. Denver lost at home to Portland last game.
Portland 5-1 but Ja Morant out. Phoenix 1-4. Low confidence.
Spurs favoured by 11.5 behind Wembanyama. Dallas moneyline needs about 5.90+.
Lakers 6-2; Kings 1-6 but won in Dallas two days ago.
Two struggling teams, close to a coin flip. Fontecchio (MIA) questionable.
